_comment: Minimal Estimate output for the decision-gate oracle. Carries the keys estimation-infra.schema.json marks required (phase, pricing_source.status, complexity_tier, recommendation.path) so scripts/validate-artifacts.py --fixtures keeps this golden on-contract; check_expected_decide.py reads only projected_costs, current_costs and recommendation.outcome*.

projected_costs._premium_basis: Declared basis: Fargate 50, RDS db.t4g.micro single-AZ 14, other lines 91 (S3, ALB, NAT Gateway, security baseline, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager/ECR). Premium = Balanced 155 + 12 RDS Multi-AZ uplift (14 -> 26 at the cached Multi-AZ rate) = 167; no other line has an AZ-rate variant.
projected_costs._optimized_basis: Eligible subtotal 50 = Fargate 50 (Compute Savings Plan 30%, mid-point of 20-40% -> 15); ineligible subtotal 105 unchanged (S3, ALB, NAT Gateway, security baseline, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager/ECR, plus RDS 14). RDS db.t4g.micro 14 is ineligible for the Database Savings Plan: it is Generation 4 and Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only (AWS Savings Plans FAQ, read 2026-11-27); a Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g) would qualify at 20%. 155 - 15 = 140.
